name: USDtb

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: none: a change applies at once

narrative.summary: One EOA (an account with no contract code) holds both DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE and the ProxyAdmin owner() of this stablecoin, whose supply was about 475M tokens on 2026-10-28. We found no multisig, timelock or DAO on that path.
narrative.detail: The same EOA also holds admin on two other proxies (fUSD, aBTC) with negligible real usage, so those are not scored as their own targets. The USDtb PSM (next card) moved from a multisig to a 24h Timelock on 2026-07-13; for the upgrade path of this token we found no similar change. The docs say the token has been issued by Anchorage Digital Bank since October 2025 (docs.ethena.fi), so the key may belong to the issuer. We have not confirmed who holds it.

steps.what: the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (13 at the read)

independent_read_reproduce.curl:
# the admin slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the word is the admin address
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xc139190f447e929f090edeb554d95abb8b18ac1c","0xb53127684a568b3173ae13b9f8a6016e243e63b6e8ee1178d6a717850b5d6103","latest"]}'
# owner() on the address the slot returned (a ProxyAdmin): the holder
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_call","params":[{"to":"<address from the slot>","data":"0x8da5cb5b"},"latest"]}'
# eth_getCode on the holder: 0x means a plain key
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getCode","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
# the implementation slot of the proxy (EIP-1967): the code behind it, an upgrade changes this word
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getStorageAt","params":["0xc139190f447e929f090edeb554d95abb8b18ac1c","0x360894a13ba1a3210667c828492db98dca3e2076cc3735a920a3ca505d382bbc","latest"]}'
# eth_getTransactionCount on the holder: how many transactions this key has sent (13 at the read)
curl -s -X POST https://ethereum-rpc.publicnode.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"eth_getTransactionCount","params":["<holder>","latest"]}'
independent_read_reproduce.note: read between blocks 26250101 and 26250103 of the chain; this RPC cannot replay the block of the read (it ignores the block tag, or no longer serves old state): the answers are the current ones

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)

main_gap.requirement: Admin power is not a bare key
main_gap.reason: One key, or a tiny group, can change it

independent_read.posture: admin: a plain key, 13 transactions sent; delay: none
